facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's ESDP VI gives a baseline of 'None' both for a student database and for a system using digital technology for school information and data on pupils' daily schooling, and 0 for institutions networked for EMIS; the plan gives no date for these baselines, so the publication year 2021 is used.
facts.system: Student database and digital application for pupils' daily school data

facts.fact: ESDP VI (2020/21-2024/25) plans a student database, an integrated data system using school, teacher and student identifiers, an individual student tracking system and a digital application for schools to collect and report pupils' daily school data, with a target of 100%; dated to the plan's publication year, 2021.
facts.system: Student database and digital application for pupils' daily school data

facts.fact: ESDP VI names the Ministry of Education and its EMIS directorate as the source and holder of the planned student database and assigns the regional bureaux and the ministry the planned digital school-data system; dated to the plan's publication year, 2021.
